$comment: Declares every GitHub Actions environment key the deploy workflows read, classified as 'secret' (encrypted) or 'variable' (plain). Values live in a git-ignored .github-env.<env>.local file, never here. Consumed by scripts/sync-github-env.mjs. When a workflow starts reading a new secrets.X / vars.X, add it here so the sync stays authoritative.

AZURE_CLIENT_ID.desc: App Registration client ID (GitHub OIDC login)

API_ADMIN_TOKEN.desc: Bearer token for super-admin API calls in deploy steps (outbox pause/resume, reconcile)

CONVEX_SYNC_URL.desc: Convex deployment URL the API projects into. Self-hosted App Service for staging.

CONVEX_SYNC_ADMIN_KEY.desc: Admin key the API uses for projection writes

CONVEX_INSTANCE_SECRET.desc: Self-hosted Convex INSTANCE_SECRET (hex). Staging Convex stack only.

CONVEX_POSTGRES_URL.desc: Self-hosted Convex Postgres URL (host only, no db/query). Staging Convex stack only.

CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_ADMIN_KEY.desc: Admin key for the Convex CLI / function deploy. Same value as CONVEX_SYNC_ADMIN_KEY for self-hosted.

EMAIL_SANDBOX_TO.desc: Resend sandbox recipient override (API config.email.sandboxTo). Not wired through deploy-api.yml — set on App Service directly if needed.

VITE_API_URL.desc: API base URL baked into the UI bundle

VITE_CONVEX_URL.desc: Convex URL for realtime, baked into the UI bundle
